name: Quilladin
description: Quilladin, the Spiny Armor Pokémon, and the evolved form of Chespin. Able to evolve into Chesnaught. A Grass type.
pokedex_entries: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.
